findings.description: Critical: Archiving the MODIFIED `OpenBao Secret Backend` and `OpenBao Configuration Dataclass` requirements deletes the base-spec `_load_secrets()` / `OpenBaoConfig` contract that still authenticates with `BAO_ROLE_ID`+`BAO_SECRET_ID` (and is used by `profile_loader._load_secrets_openbao` and `resolve_dynamic_dsn`). The ADDED CFG-19 only renames inputs to `BAO_INTERNAL_*` in one thin scenario and does not restate auth-failure/missing-credential/unreachable behaviors or redefine `OpenBaoConfig.from_env`/`create_client`. Tasks 3.7–3.8 mention only `profile_loader.py`, so implementers can satisfy the task text while leaving `config.py` on legacy env vars—or repurpose `OpenBaoConfig` for bootstrap bundles and strand internal+DB loading.
findings.resolution: Split the contracts: keep a MODIFIED/ADDED requirement that `OpenBaoConfig` (or a dedicated internal config) reads `BAO_INTERNAL_ROLE_ID`/`BAO_INTERNAL_SECRET_ID` and preserves the existing `_load_secrets` failure scenarios under those names; keep the bootstrap-dir dataclass as a separately named adapter requirement. Extend tasks 3.7–3.8 to update `agent-coordinator/src/config.py` and `tests/test_openbao_config.py` explicitly.

findings.description: Critical: `wp-projection` owns `packages/openbao-credentials/**` and both `agent-coordinator/pyproject.toml` path dependency manifests, but `agent-coordinator/Dockerfile` COPY of that package is deferred to `wp-integration` tasks 5.5–5.6. Existing packages (`gen-eval`, etc.) are COPY'd into `/packages/...` during the image build so `uv sync` can resolve path deps; CI `check-docker-imports` / `docker-smoke-import` will fail as soon as coordinator code depends on the new package before integration lands.
findings.resolution: Move the Dockerfile (builder+runtime) COPY for `packages/openbao-credentials/`—and any smoke-import module updates—into `wp-projection` write_allow/tasks (or make `wp-coordinator` depend on a packaging package that owns the Dockerfile) so the first merge that adds the path dependency keeps the container build green.

findings.description: Nit: Removing `openbao_role_id` from the registry/`get_dispatch_configs` export (agents_config.py:1891) will break `agent-coordinator/tests/model_routing/test_agent_endpoints.py`, which asserts `"openbao_role_id": None` in the dispatch config payload. That test file is not in any package `write_allow`, so the owning package cannot land the schema/export change without an out-of-scope edit or a red suite.
findings.resolution: Add `agent-coordinator/tests/model_routing/test_agent_endpoints.py` to `wp-projection` write_allow (and verification), or keep a transitional dispatch-config field until a listed package updates the assertion.

findings.description: Nit: `contracts/README.md` states the agent KV logical path is `<mount>/agents/<name>`, but `principal-topology.schema.json` `agent_kv_path` is mount-relative (`^agents/[a-z]...$`), CFG-03/`design.md` D1 require hvac to receive `agents/<name>` at the configured mount, and the same README later correctly says adapters pass mount-relative logical paths. Implementers following the first sentence will generate wrong hvac paths.
findings.resolution: Change the README projection rule to: logical KV path `agents/<name>` (mount-relative); policy API path `<mount>/data/agents/<name>`.
